_comment: Run configuration for pipeline/run_pipeline.py.
starting_bankroll        - used only on the first run; afterwards the
ledger in bankroll.json is the source of truth.
staking_limits           - exposure caps, as fractions of the STAKING
bankroll (settled balance less stake already
committed to open bets).
max_stake_fraction: no single bet above this.
Clamped automatically; every clamp is logged.
max_weekly_stake_fraction: no week's total
above this. FLAGGED, never silently rescaled --
which bet to drop is an operator decision.
These live here rather than in bankroll.json
because Ledger.save() rewrites that file from a
fixed set of keys and would discard them.
low_confidence_bands     - ELO bands thin enough that a play in them is
sized at Eighth-Kelly rather than Quarter.
Bands 9 and 10 hold 6 and 4 matches, so their
rates are not yet worth a full-confidence stake.
correlation_explanations - keyed 'selection_a+selection_b'. Supplying an
entry is how you take a correlated pair on one
fixture KNOWINGLY. With no entry, the pair is
blocked. Two +EV selections in the SAME market
can never be unblocked this way -- that is a
model-recheck signal, not a bet.
